learning_outcomes.text: The listeners can describe the essential properties of mechanical and thermal process engineering processes.

They can differentiate the most important designs and functionalities of process engineering apparatuses and are able to analyze and interpret a coupling of individual Unit Operations (e.g. Thermal Process Engineering, Multiphase Flow, Energy Utilization) in an overall process.
Furthermore, students are able to present the fundamental properties and structure of polymers.
They can sketch simple plastic processing procedures and calculate simple components in a plastic-appropriate manner.
They are also able to use the acquired knowledge from the field of polymer materials science, polymer processing, polymer finishing, joining and polymer disposal to solve specific problems.

Students possess basic knowledge of machining, forming, and joining manufacturing processes and are able to classify the fundamental properties such as manufacturing accuracy and surface quality of manufacturing processes.
They know conceptual and theoretical foundations as well as interrelationships in manufacturing technology to understand overarching problems.
On this basis, students can select and explain suitable manufacturing processes or joining processes according to the specified requirements for a product to be manufactured.
They can sketch simple manufacturing processes and design simple components for manufacturing.
Furthermore, students are able to estimate process limits or propose suitable manufacturing strategies based on specific problems.

syllabus_topics: Sustainable process engineering using the example of a complete production process
Machining with geometrically undefined and geometrically defined cutting edge
Bulk forming processes for semi-finished product manufacturing
Bulk forming processes for discrete part manufacturing
Basic processes of sheet metal forming

assessment_methods.method: Exam for Fundamentals of Process Engineering and Plastics Processing
Exam for Fundamentals of Manufacturing Technology

assessment_rules: The module final examination consists of two partial examinations. The first exam for Fundamentals of Process Engineering and Plastics Processing will be 120-150 minutes, and the second exam for Fundamentals of Manufacturing Technology will be 60-90 minutes. Students must pass the module final examination to be awarded credit points. In the exam, students should select, sketch, and explain suitable process and manufacturing techniques for exemplary problems and justify their choice based on theoretical comparisons or analytical calculations.
